[Benzinga news, 2026-10-27T22:01:52Z, by staff] Amazon's Acquisition of Globalstar Receives Approval From FCC
The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has approved the transfer of Globalstar's licenses to Amazon as part of its acquisition of the satellite telecommunications company.
The FCC has granted authorization for the transfer of various Globalstar, Inc. licenses to Amazon, including space station licenses, earth station licenses, and domestic and international section 214 authorizations. This regulatory approval is a key component of Amazon's broader acquisition of the satellite telecommunications provider. The agency's decision facilitates the integration of Globalstar's assets into Amazon's operations.
